title: Property in a mine subsidence district
summary: Find out what to do if your property is located in a mine subsidence district.

internal_links.text: Check if a property is in a Mine Subsidence District
Claim compensation for mine subsidence damage

faqs.q: What is a mine subsidence district?
faqs.a: A mine subsidence district is an area where the ground may be affected by mining activities, which can cause subsidence (sinking or settling of the ground).

faqs.q: What should I do if my property is in a mine subsidence district?
faqs.a: You should check if your property is in a mine subsidence district and, if necessary, claim compensation for any damage.
